name: @abaddon83/trading212-mcp

tools.name: get_account_summary
tools.description: Get account summary: cash and investment metrics (free/blocked cash, invested value, result, account ID, currency). Rate limit: 1 req / 5s.

tools.name: get_exchanges
tools.description: Get all accessible exchanges and their working schedules. Rate limit: 1 req / 30s.

tools.name: get_instruments
tools.description: Get all tradable instruments (tickers, names, types, currencies). The full list has thousands of entries, so pass `search` to filter it. Rate limit: 1 req / 50s.

search.description: Case-insensitive substring filter applied locally on ticker, name and shortName

tools.name: get_pending_orders
tools.description: Get all pending (not yet executed) equity orders. Rate limit: 1 req / 5s.

tools.name: get_order_by_id
tools.description: Get a single pending order by its numeric ID. Rate limit: 1 req / 1s.

id.description: The unique identifier of the order

tools.name: place_limit_order
tools.description: Place a Limit order (executes at the specified price or better). Negative quantity sells. Rate limit: 1 req / 2s.

quantity.description: Quantity to trade. Use a NEGATIVE value to sell (e.g. -10.5), positive to buy.

timeValidity.description: Order expiration: DAY (expires at exchange midnight) or GOOD_TILL_CANCEL (active until filled or cancelled)

tools.name: place_market_order
tools.description: Place a Market order (executes at the current market price). Negative quantity sells. Rate limit: 50 req / 1m.

quantity.description: Quantity to trade. Use a NEGATIVE value to sell (e.g. -10.5), positive to buy.

extendedHours.description: Allow execution during extended trading hours (default false)

tools.name: place_stop_order
tools.description: Place a Stop order (triggers a Market order once the stop price is reached). Negative quantity sells. Rate limit: 1 req / 2s.

quantity.description: Quantity to trade. Use a NEGATIVE value to sell (e.g. -10.5), positive to buy.

timeValidity.description: Order expiration: DAY (expires at exchange midnight) or GOOD_TILL_CANCEL (active until filled or cancelled)

tools.name: place_stop_limit_order
tools.description: Place a Stop-Limit order (triggers a Limit order once the stop price is reached). Negative quantity sells. Rate limit: 1 req / 2s.

quantity.description: Quantity to trade. Use a NEGATIVE value to sell (e.g. -10.5), positive to buy.

timeValidity.description: Order expiration: DAY (expires at exchange midnight) or GOOD_TILL_CANCEL (active until filled or cancelled)

tools.name: cancel_order
tools.description: Cancel a pending (unfilled) order by its numeric ID. Rate limit: 50 req / 1m.

id.description: The unique identifier of the order to cancel

tools.name: get_positions
tools.description: Get all open positions (quantity, average price, current P/L), optionally filtered by ticker. Rate limit: 1 req / 1s.

ticker.description: Filter by instrument ticker, e.g. AAPL_US_EQ

tools.name: get_order_history
tools.description: Get historical (executed/cancelled) orders. Paginated: follow the returned nextPagePath cursor until it is null. Rate limit: 6 req / 1m.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor (from nextPagePath of the previous response)

ticker.description: Filter by instrument ticker, e.g. AAPL_US_EQ

tools.name: get_dividends
tools.description: Get paid-out dividends. Paginated: follow the returned nextPagePath cursor until it is null. Rate limit: 6 req / 1m.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor (from nextPagePath of the previous response)

ticker.description: Filter by instrument ticker, e.g. AAPL_US_EQ

tools.name: get_transactions
tools.description: Get cash movements to and from the account. Paginated via cursor. Rate limit: 6 req / 1m.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor (from nextPagePath of the previous response)

time.description: Retrieve transactions starting from this time (ISO 8601 date-time)

tools.name: get_report_exports
tools.description: List all requested CSV report exports and their current status. Rate limit: 1 req / 1m.

tools.name: request_report_export
tools.description: Request generation of a CSV report of historical account data (orders, dividends, interest, transactions) for a time range. Rate limit: 1 req / 30s.

tools.name: get_pies
tools.description: Fetch all investment pies for the account. (Deprecated upstream but operational.) Rate limit: 1 req / 30s.

tools.name: get_pie
tools.description: Fetch one pie with detailed information by its numeric ID. (Deprecated upstream but operational.) Rate limit: 1 req / 5s.

tools.name: create_pie
tools.description: Create an investment pie. (Deprecated upstream but operational.) Rate limit: 1 req / 5s.

dividendCashAction.description: What to do with dividends received by the pie

goal.description: Total desired value of the pie in account currency

instrumentShares.description: Map of ticker to target weight, weights must sum to 1, e.g. {"AAPL_US_EQ": 0.5, "MSFT_US_EQ": 0.5}

tools.name: update_pie
tools.description: Update an existing pie by its numeric ID. (Deprecated upstream but operational.) Rate limit: 1 req / 5s.

dividendCashAction.description: What to do with dividends received by the pie

goal.description: Total desired value of the pie in account currency

instrumentShares.description: Map of ticker to target weight, weights must sum to 1, e.g. {"AAPL_US_EQ": 0.5, "MSFT_US_EQ": 0.5}

tools.name: duplicate_pie
tools.description: Duplicate an existing pie by its numeric ID. (Deprecated upstream but operational.) Rate limit: 1 req / 5s.

tools.name: delete_pie
tools.description: Delete a pie by its numeric ID. (Deprecated upstream but operational.) Rate limit: 1 req / 5s.
